messages.subject: Strategic value creation brief | Company Name
messages.body:
Dear Named Executive,

I have prepared a concise strategic assessment of several areas where my experience may be relevant to Company Name's priorities. Rather than sending a conventional application, I wanted to demonstrate how I would think about the organisation, the challenges ahead and where I could potentially contribute.

The attached paper is specific to Company Name and sets out practical opportunities, a 90-180 day action framework and the potential business impact. My three-page executive CV is included as the final three pages for background.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
